content: Minimizer theory: random density~2/(w+1), lower bound 1/w, miniception<=1.67/w; open syncmers~1/(k-s+1). Canonical via min(fwd,rc) can DESTROY window guarantee (Marcais 2024); t=0 syncmers keep strong guarantee. Non-uniformity: lexicographic/KMC2 orders skewed (max bin ratio 367/166), random/minimap2 flat (~9-10)->use random/ntHash order or KMC forbidden-pattern signatures to avoid giant bins. UHS limited to k<=16 (not directly usable k=21). simd-minimizers canonical requires odd l=w+k-1.
